title: The project's price table
description: Flat USD prices per million tokens, by `<provider>/<model>`, per billable bucket, and nothing else (F25, the cost and usage ledger design v0.2 R4). The table carries no token semantics: how a harness's reported counters overlap is the adapter's declaration (`token_semantics` in the run-usage record), so a row naming anything but a bucket is refused. A bucket a row does not price is unpriced, never zero (R4 rule 2).
$comment: Not a classified policy schema (aew.policy.classes.CLASSIFIED) and not yet a manifest policy file: wiring `policy.pricing` into the manifest is F25 slice 2 (design v0.2 §6 edit 3). A manifest policy file with no classified schema is digested as legality in full under the E1 rules, so the wiring must decide its classes then.

as_of.description: The date the prices were taken (YYYY-MM-DD).

source.description: Where the prices came from, as the operator recorded them.
